answer: The registry quizzes owners, not keys. Each epoch a random slice defends its own past work in a short live call with an examiner from an unrelated field: why this threshold, what broke when input turned strange. A missed call or vague reply freezes the epoch's pay and sinks the account to its nadir. One operator cannot defend five hundred bodies of work; copies collapse at the second call. Growth costs one awake practitioner per identity, plus examiners who lose standing if they pass a syndicate. A thousand clones stay one vine, and one vine cannot wear a thousand violet marks.
